sw.B: Kisha Sofari Mnaamathi akajibu:

vi.B: Bấy giờ Sô-pha người Na-a-ma đáp:

ko.L: 그러자 나아마 사람 소발이 대답하여 말했다.
ko.B: 그러자 나아마 사람 소발이 대답했다.
ko.R: 그러자 나아마 사람 소발이 말했다.

decisions.choice: answered and said: Zophar replies to Job's speech in chapters 9-10
decisions.reason: This is Zophar's first speech. He is the third of Job's friends to speak, after Eliphaz (chapters 4-5) and Bildad (chapter 8), and he answers what Job has just said. Like the other speech introductions in Job, this line stays prose.

decisions.choice: the Naamathite: a man from a place called Naamah
decisions.reason: Zophar is named with his two friends in 2:11. The place he came from is not known; it is not likely to be the town of Naamah in Judah (Joshua 15:41), since all three friends seem to come from lands east and south of Israel.

decisions.choice: answered (Balanced), said (Readable), without "and said"
decisions.reason: Hebrew introduces speech with two verbs, "answered and said". Literal keeps both; Balanced and Readable say it once, with the same wording at every speech introduction in Job.

decisions.choice: « répondit et dit » (L), « répondit » (B): passé simple; « a dit » (R): passé composé
decisions.reason: The speech introductions are narrative, so French uses the passé simple at Literal and Balanced and the passé composé at Readable; the speeches themselves are in the present and passé composé.

source.text: הֲרֹ֣ב דְּ֭בָרִים לֹ֣א יֵעָנֶ֑ה וְאִם־אִ֖ישׁ שְׂפָתַ֣יִם יִצְדָּֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: [Is] a multitude of words not to be answered? Or a man of lips, will he be in the right?

en.L: Shall a multitude of words not be answered? \q Or shall a man of lips be in the right?
en.B: Should such a flood of words go unanswered? \q Should a man be proved right by talking?
en.R: Should all these words go without an answer? \q Can a man be proved right just because he talks a lot?

es.L: ¿Una multitud de palabras no será respondida? \q ¿O un hombre de labios tendrá la razón?
es.B: ¿Debe quedar sin respuesta tal torrente de palabras? \q ¿Tendrá razón un hombre a fuerza de hablar?
es.R: ¿Deben quedar sin respuesta todas estas palabras? \q ¿Tiene razón un hombre solo porque habla mucho?

fr.L: Une multitude de paroles ne recevra-t-elle pas de réponse ? \q Ou un homme de lèvres aura-t-il raison ?
fr.B: Un tel flot de paroles doit-il rester sans réponse ? \q Un homme aura-t-il raison à force de parler ?
fr.R: Tous ces mots doivent-ils rester sans réponse ? \q Un homme a-t-il raison simplement parce qu’il parle beaucoup ?

sw.L: Je, wingi wa maneno hautajibiwa? \q Au mtu wa midomo atakuwa na haki?
sw.B: Je, mafuriko ya maneno kama haya yaachwe bila jibu? \q Je, mtu ataonekana kuwa na haki kwa kuongea tu?
sw.R: Je, maneno haya yote yakose jibu? \q Je, mtu anakuwa sahihi kwa sababu tu anaongea sana?

vi.L: Lẽ nào nhiều lời như thế lại không được đáp lại? \q Hay người của môi miệng sẽ được xem là công chính?
vi.B: Lẽ nào cả một tràng lời như thế lại không ai đáp? \q Lẽ nào cứ nói nhiều là được xem là đúng?
vi.R: Lẽ nào bao nhiêu lời ấy lại không có ai trả lời? \q Một người nói nhiều thì có phải là người đúng không?

ko.L: 많은 말에 대답이 없어야 하겠소? \q 입술의 사람이 옳다 함을 받겠소?
ko.B: 이렇게 쏟아지는 말에 대답하지 말아야 하겠소? \q 말만 많이 한다고 사람이 옳다고 인정받겠소?
ko.R: 이 많은 말에 아무 대답도 하지 말아야 하겠소? \q 말을 많이 한다고 해서 옳은 사람이 되겠소?

decisions.choice: a question that expects the answer no: so many words must be answered
decisions.reason: Zophar uses two questions to explain why he speaks. He means that Job's long speeches (chapters 9-10) should not go unanswered, and that talking does not make Job right.

decisions.choice: a man of lips: a man full of talk
decisions.reason: "Lips" stands for speech, as "a man of words" means a good speaker in Exodus 4:10. Here the phrase is a put-down: a man who talks much. It points at Job himself, so it is not made general.

decisions.choice: be in the right: be declared innocent, win one's case
decisions.reason: The verb (tsadaq) is a law-court word. Job has asked how a man can be in the right with God (9:2) and said that even if he were in the right he could not answer him (9:15, 20). Zophar turns Job's word back on him.

decisions.choice: such a flood of words; by talking (B); all these words; because he talks a lot (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the Hebrew pictures mean (m2); Literal keeps them.

source.text: בַּ֭דֶּיךָ מְתִ֣ים יַחֲרִ֑ישׁווַ֝תִּלְעַ֗ג וְאֵ֣ין מַכְלִֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Your idle talk, men will it silence? And you mock, and there is no one putting [you] to shame?

en.L: Shall your idle talk silence {{gender:people|men}}? \q And you mock, and no one puts [you] to shame?
en.B: Should your empty talk reduce {{gender:people|men}} to silence? \q When you mock, should no one shame you?
en.R: Should your empty talk make everyone stop speaking? \q When you mock, should no one make you feel ashamed?

es.L: ¿Tu palabrería hará callar a {{gender:la gente|los hombres}}? \q ¿Y te burlas, y no hay quien [te] avergüence?
es.B: ¿Tus palabras vacías reducirán al silencio a {{gender:la gente|los hombres}}? \q Cuando te burlas, ¿nadie te avergonzará?
es.R: ¿Tus palabras vacías harán callar a todos? \q Cuando te burlas, ¿nadie te hará sentir vergüenza?

fr.L: Ton bavardage fera-t-il taire {{gender:les humains|les hommes}} ? \q Et tu te moques, et personne ne [te] fait honte ?
fr.B: Tes paroles creuses réduiront-elles {{gender:les humains|les hommes}} au silence ? \q Tu te moques, et personne ne te ferait honte ?
fr.R: Tes paroles vides vont-elles faire taire tout le monde ? \q Quand tu te moques, personne ne doit-il te faire honte ?

sw.L: Je, maneno yako matupu yatawanyamazisha watu? \q Nawe unadhihaki, wala hakuna [mtu wa] kukuaibisha?
sw.B: Je, maneno yako matupu yawanyamazishe watu? \q Unapodhihaki, kusiwe na mtu wa kukuaibisha?
sw.R: Je, maneno yako matupu yawanyamazishe watu wote? \q Unapodhihaki, kusiwe na mtu wa kukufanya uone aibu?

vi.L: Lời khoe khoang trống rỗng của anh sẽ làm người ta im lặng sao? \q Anh chế nhạo mà không có ai làm [anh] hổ thẹn sao?
vi.B: Lẽ nào lời rỗng tuếch của anh khiến người ta phải im lặng? \q Anh chế nhạo mà không ai làm anh xấu hổ sao?
vi.R: Lẽ nào những lời trống rỗng của anh làm mọi người phải im miệng? \q Anh chế nhạo mà không ai làm cho anh biết xấu hổ sao?

ko.L: 그대의 헛된 말이 사람들을 잠잠하게 하겠소? \q 그대가 조롱하는데 [그대를] 부끄럽게 할 자가 없겠소?
ko.B: 그대의 빈말에 사람들이 입을 다물어야 하겠소? \q 그대가 조롱하는데 아무도 그대를 부끄럽게 하지 말아야 하겠소?
ko.R: 그대의 빈말 때문에 모두가 입을 다물어야 하겠소? \q 그대가 비웃는데 아무도 그대에게 부끄러운 줄 알게 하지 말아야 하겠소?

decisions.choice: idle talk: empty boasting, babble
decisions.reason: The noun (bad) means empty or boastful talk. It is used of Moab's proud boasting (Isaiah 16:6; Jeremiah 48:30). Zophar calls Job's speeches empty words.

decisions.choice: men: people in general, here those who hear Job
decisions.reason: The word (metim) is a poetic word for men or mortals. Zophar means anyone listening, his friends and himself among them, who might be silenced by Job's flood of words.

decisions.choice: you mock: Job's words are taken as mockery, with no object named
decisions.reason: Zophar does not say whom Job mocks. He may mean Job's charge that God treats the innocent and the guilty alike (9:22-24), or his scorn for his friends' advice (6:14-30). The translation leaves the object open, as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: {{gender:people|men}}
decisions.reason: The word means people in general, men and women, so the gender setting gives "people" by default. Readable says "everyone".

source.text: וַ֭תֹּאמֶר זַ֣ךְ לִקְחִ֑י וּ֝בַ֗ר הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you have said, Pure [is] my teaching, and clean I am in your eyes.

en.L: And you have said, 'My teaching [is] pure, \q and I am clean in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes.'
en.B: For you say, 'My teaching is sound, \q and I am clean in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sight.'
en.R: You say to God, 'What I teach is right, \q and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} can see that I am pure.'

es.L: Y has dicho: “Mi enseñanza [es] pura, \q y limpio soy ante {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos”.
es.B: Pues dices: “Mi enseñanza es sana, \q y soy limpio a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos”.
es.R: Tú le dices a Dios: “Lo que enseño es correcto, \q y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} ves que soy puro”.

fr.L: Et tu as dit : “Mon enseignement [est] pur, \q et je suis net à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux.”
fr.B: Car tu dis : “Mon enseignement est sain, \q et je suis pur à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux.”
fr.R: Tu dis à Dieu : “Ce que j’enseigne est juste, \q et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vois bien que je suis pur.”

sw.L: Nawe umesema, 'Mafundisho yangu [ni] safi, \q nami ni safi machoni {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}}.'
sw.B: Kwa maana unasema, 'Mafundisho yangu ni sahihi, \q nami ni safi mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.'
sw.R: Unamwambia Mungu, 'Ninachofundisha ni sahihi, \q na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unaona kwamba mimi ni safi.'

vi.L: Anh đã nói: 'Lời dạy của con [là] tinh sạch, \q và con trong sạch trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.'
vi.B: Vì anh nói: 'Điều con dạy là đúng đắn, \q và con trong sạch trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.'
vi.R: Anh thưa với Đức Chúa Trời: 'Điều con dạy là đúng, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy con là người trong sạch.'

ko.L: 그대는 말하였소. '저의 가르침은 순수하고, \q 저는 주님의 눈에 깨끗합니다.'
ko.B: 그대는 이렇게 말하오. '제 가르침은 바르고, \q 저는 주님 보시기에 깨끗합니다.'
ko.R: 그대는 하나님께 이렇게 말하오. '제가 가르치는 것은 옳습니다. \q 주님도 제가 깨끗하다는 것을 보십니다.'

decisions.choice: my teaching: what I have learned and put forward
decisions.reason: The word (leqach) means teaching or instruction, what is received and passed on (Deuteronomy 32:2; Proverbs 4:2). Zophar sums up Job's claims in his own words; Job never said exactly this.

decisions.choice: your eyes: God's eyes; the second line is addressed to God
decisions.reason: In the quotation Job speaks to God, as he did in 10:7 ("you know that I am not guilty") and 9:21. So "your" in the quotation means God.

decisions.choice: clean: pure in heart and conduct
decisions.reason: The adjective (bar) means clean or pure, as in "a pure heart" (Psalm 24:4; 73:1). Zophar takes Job to be claiming that he has no sin at all.

decisions.choice: You say to God
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one Job is said to address, so that "you" in the quotation is clear (m2).

decisions.choice: In the words Zophar puts in Job's mouth, Job calls himself "con" before God
decisions.reason: When Job speaks to God he calls himself "con" and God "Ngài" or "Chúa", as in the laments of the Psalms; the quotation follows that form.

decisions.choice: The quoted words to God in 합쇼체 with "저" and "주님"; no deity_pronoun spans in Korean
decisions.reason: Job speaks to God in 합쇼체, as the Psalms' laments. Korean has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change; respect is shown by "주님" and the honorific.

source.text: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם מִֽי־יִתֵּ֣ן אֱל֣וֹהַּ דַּבֵּ֑ר וְיִפְתַּ֖ח שְׂפָתָ֣יו עִמָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: But who will give God to speak, and he will open his lips with you.

en.L: But oh that God would speak, \q and open {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} lips with you!
en.B: But oh, if only God would speak, \q and open {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} lips against you!
en.R: But I wish God would speak \q and argue against you {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}!

es.L: Pero ¡oh, si Dios hablara, \q y abriera {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} labios contigo!
es.B: Pero ¡ojalá Dios hablara, \q y abriera {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} labios contra ti!
es.R: ¡Cómo quisiera que Dios hablara \q y que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo te rebatiera!

fr.L: Mais oh ! si Dieu parlait, \q et ouvrait {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lèvres avec toi !
fr.B: Mais ah ! si seulement Dieu parlait, \q s’il ouvrait {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lèvres contre toi !
fr.R: Mais je voudrais que Dieu parle \q et qu’il plaide {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}-même contre toi !

sw.L: Lakini laiti Mungu angesema, \q na kufungua midomo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} pamoja nawe!
sw.B: Lakini laiti Mungu angesema, \q akafungua midomo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} dhidi yako!
sw.R: Lakini natamani Mungu aseme \q na abishane nawe {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} mwenyewe!

vi.L: Nhưng ôi, ước gì Đức Chúa Trời phán, \q và mở môi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với anh!
vi.B: Nhưng ôi, ước gì Đức Chúa Trời lên tiếng, \q mở môi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra chống lại anh!
vi.R: Nhưng tôi ước gì Đức Chúa Trời lên tiếng \q và chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tranh luận với anh!

ko.L: 그러나 하나님께서 말씀하시고, \q 그대와 더불어 그분의 입술을 여시기를 바라오!
ko.B: 그러나 아, 하나님께서 말씀하시고 \q 그대를 향해 입을 여신다면 좋겠소!
ko.R: 나는 하나님께서 말씀하셔서 \q 직접 그대와 따져 주시기를 바라오!

decisions.choice: who will give: if only, I wish
decisions.reason: "Who will give ..." is the usual Hebrew way to express a wish (Deuteronomy 5:29; Job 6:8).

decisions.choice: with you: against you, as an opponent in a dispute
decisions.reason: In a dispute "with" means "against" (9:3, "contend with him"). Job has asked for a hearing in which God would speak and he could answer (9:32-35; 10:2). Zophar wishes for the same hearing, sure that God's words would go against Job.

decisions.choice: against you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that God would speak as Job's opponent (m2); Literal keeps "with".

source.text: וְיַגֶּד־לְךָ֨׀תַּֽעֲלֻמ֣וֹת חָכְמָה֮ כִּֽי־כִפְלַ֪יִם לְֽת֫וּשִׁיָּ֥ה וְדַ֡ע כִּֽי־יַשֶּׁ֥ה לְךָ֥ אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ מֵעֲוֺנֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: and may he tell you [the] secrets of wisdom, that double [it is] to sound wisdom; and know that God causes to be forgotten for you [some] of your iniquity.

en.L: and tell you the secrets of wisdom, \q for sound wisdom is double! \q And know that God lets [some] of your iniquity be forgotten for you.
en.B: and show you the secrets of wisdom, \q for true wisdom has two sides. \q Know then that God has overlooked part of your guilt.
en.R: I wish {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would tell you the secrets of wisdom, \q because true wisdom is much deeper than it seems. \q You should know that God is punishing you less than your sins deserve.

es.L: y te declarara los secretos de la sabiduría, \q ¡pues doble es la sabiduría sólida! \q Y sabe que Dios hace olvidar para ti [parte] de tu iniquidad.
es.B: y te mostrara los secretos de la sabiduría, \q porque la verdadera sabiduría tiene dos caras. \q Sabe, pues, que Dios ha pasado por alto parte de tu culpa.
es.R: Quisiera que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te contara los secretos de la sabiduría, \q porque la verdadera sabiduría es mucho más profunda de lo que parece. \q Debes saber que Dios te castiga menos de lo que merecen tus pecados.

fr.L: et qu’il te dise les secrets de la sagesse, \q car la sagesse solide est double ! \q Et sache que Dieu fait oublier pour toi [une part] de ton iniquité.
fr.B: et qu’il te montre les secrets de la sagesse, \q car la vraie sagesse a deux faces. \q Sache donc que Dieu a passé sur une part de ta faute.
fr.R: Je voudrais qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te dise les secrets de la sagesse, \q car la vraie sagesse est bien plus profonde qu’elle n’en a l’air. \q Sache que Dieu te punit moins que tes péchés ne le méritent.

sw.L: na akuambie siri za hekima, \q kwa maana hekima thabiti ni maradufu! \q Nawe ujue kwamba Mungu anakusahaulia [sehemu] ya uovu wako.
sw.B: na akuonyeshe siri za hekima, \q kwa maana hekima ya kweli ina pande mbili. \q Basi ujue kwamba Mungu ameiachilia sehemu ya hatia yako.
sw.R: Natamani {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} akuambie siri za hekima, \q kwa sababu hekima ya kweli ina kina kuliko inavyoonekana. \q Ujue kwamba Mungu anakuadhibu kidogo kuliko dhambi zako zinavyostahili.

vi.L: và nói cho anh những điều bí ẩn của sự khôn ngoan, \q vì sự khôn ngoan chân thật thì gấp đôi! \q Và hãy biết rằng Đức Chúa Trời để cho [một phần] tội lỗi của anh bị quên đi.
vi.B: và bày tỏ cho anh những bí ẩn của sự khôn ngoan, \q vì sự khôn ngoan thật có hai mặt. \q Vậy hãy biết rằng Đức Chúa Trời đã bỏ qua một phần tội lỗi của anh.
vi.R: Tôi ước gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói cho anh biết những bí mật của sự khôn ngoan, \q vì sự khôn ngoan thật sâu xa hơn vẻ bề ngoài nhiều. \q Anh nên biết rằng Đức Chúa Trời đang phạt anh nhẹ hơn tội anh đáng chịu.

ko.L: 지혜의 비밀을 그대에게 알려 주시기를 바라오. \q 참된 지혜는 두 겹이기 때문이오! \q 하나님께서 그대의 죄악 [가운데 얼마를] 잊어 주신다는 것을 알아 두시오.
ko.B: 지혜의 비밀을 그대에게 보여 주시기를 바라오. \q 참된 지혜에는 두 면이 있기 때문이오. \q 그러니 하나님께서 그대의 죄 가운데 얼마를 눈감아 주셨음을 알아 두시오.
ko.R: 그분께서 지혜의 비밀을 그대에게 말씀해 주시면 좋겠소. \q 참된 지혜는 보이는 것보다 훨씬 깊기 때문이오. \q 알아 두시오. 하나님께서는 그대의 죄보다 가볍게 그대를 벌하고 계시오.

decisions.choice: double to sound wisdom: true wisdom has two sides, a hidden one as well as the one people see
alternatives: wisdom is wonderful (reading a similar word, pela'im)
decisions.reason: The phrase is short and hard. "Double" (kiflayim) seems to mean that there is more to God's wisdom than appears, so that Job, who sees only one side, cannot judge it. Some read, with a small change, "wonders" in place of "double".

decisions.choice: causes to be forgotten: God has let part of your guilt go unpunished
alternatives: God demands of you less than your guilt (from a verb meaning to lend or demand payment)
decisions.reason: The verb (nashah) means to cause to forget. Zophar's point is clear either way: Job is suffering less than his sins deserve. It is the harshest thing any of the friends has yet said to him.

decisions.choice: iniquity: wrongdoing and the guilt it brings
decisions.reason: The word ('avon) covers both the wrong done and the guilt that follows it. Job used it of himself in 7:21 and 10:6.

decisions.choice: God is punishing you less than your sins deserve
alternatives: God has forgotten part of your guilt
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what it means for God to let part of the guilt be forgotten (m2).

source.text: הַחֵ֣קֶר אֱל֣וֹהַ תִּמְצָ֑א אִ֤ם עַד־תַּכְלִ֖ית שַׁדַּ֣י תִּמְצָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: The searching out of God can you find? Or to [the] limit of [the] Almighty can you find?

en.L: Can you find the searching out of God? \q Or can you find [your way] to the limit of the Almighty?
en.B: Can you discover the depths of God? \q Can you reach the limits of the Almighty?
en.R: Can you understand everything about God? \q Can you find out all there is to know about God All-Powerful?

es.L: ¿Hallarás lo que hay que escudriñar de Dios? \q ¿O hallarás [el camino] hasta el límite del Todopoderoso?
es.B: ¿Puedes descubrir las profundidades de Dios? \q ¿Puedes llegar a los límites del Todopoderoso?
es.R: ¿Puedes entender todo acerca de Dios? \q ¿Puedes descubrir todo lo que hay que saber del Dios Todopoderoso?

fr.L: Trouveras-tu le fond de Dieu en le sondant ? \q Ou trouveras-tu [ton chemin] jusqu’à la limite du Tout-Puissant ?
fr.B: Peux-tu découvrir les profondeurs de Dieu ? \q Peux-tu atteindre les limites du Tout-Puissant ?
fr.R: Peux-tu comprendre tout ce qu’est Dieu ? \q Peux-tu découvrir tout ce qu’il y a à savoir sur Dieu le Tout-Puissant ?

sw.L: Je, utayapata yaliyofichika ya Mungu kwa kuchunguza? \q Au utapata [njia] hadi mpaka wa Mwenyezi?
sw.B: Je, waweza kuvigundua vilindi vya Mungu? \q Je, waweza kuifikia mipaka ya Mwenyezi?
sw.R: Je, unaweza kuelewa kila kitu kuhusu Mungu? \q Je, unaweza kujua yote yanayoweza kujulikana kuhusu Mungu Mwenyezi?

vi.L: Anh dò xét mà tìm thấy được chiều sâu của Đức Chúa Trời sao? \q Hay anh tìm [được đường] đến giới hạn của Đấng Toàn Năng sao?
vi.B: Anh có thể khám phá chiều sâu của Đức Chúa Trời sao? \q Anh có thể đạt đến giới hạn của Đấng Toàn Năng sao?
vi.R: Anh có hiểu được mọi điều về Đức Chúa Trời không? \q Anh có biết hết mọi điều về Đức Chúa Trời Toàn Năng không?

ko.L: 그대가 하나님의 깊은 것을 찾아낼 수 있겠소? \q 전능자의 끝까지 [이를] 수 있겠소?
ko.B: 그대가 하나님의 깊이를 헤아릴 수 있겠소? \q 전능자의 한계에 다다를 수 있겠소?
ko.R: 그대가 하나님에 대해 모든 것을 알 수 있겠소? \q 전능하신 하나님에 대해 알아야 할 것을 다 알아낼 수 있겠소?

decisions.choice: the searching out of God: the depths of God, what could only be found by searching
decisions.reason: The noun (cheqer) means a searching, and so the deep, hidden things that searching would uncover (38:16, "the recesses of the deep"). Eliphaz said God does great things "without searching", beyond finding out (5:9), and Job agreed (9:10).

decisions.choice: the limit: the furthest end
decisions.reason: The word (takhlit) means the outer limit or end of something (26:10; 28:3). The two questions expect the answer no: no one can reach the end of what God is.

decisions.choice: the Almighty: Shaddai, an old name of God
decisions.reason: Shaddai is an ancient name of God, used most often in Job. It is rendered "the Almighty" (Readable "God All-Powerful"), as in 5:17.

decisions.choice: the depths ... the limits (B); everything ... all there is to know (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what is meant by the searching and the limit (m1, m2).

source.text: גָּבְהֵ֣י שָׁ֭מַיִם מַה־תִּפְעָ֑ל עֲמֻקָּ֥ה מִ֝שְּׁא֗וֹל מַה־תֵּדָֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: Heights of heavens, what can you do? Deeper than Sheol, what can you know?

en.L: [It is as] the heights of [the] heavens; what can you do? \q Deeper than Sheol; what can you know?
en.B: It is higher than the heavens; what can you do? \q It is deeper than Sheol; what can you know?
en.R: It is higher than the sky. What can you do? \q It is deeper than the grave. What can you know?

es.L: [Es como] las alturas de [los] cielos; ¿qué puedes hacer? \q Más profundo que el Seol; ¿qué puedes saber?
es.B: Es más alto que los cielos; ¿qué puedes hacer? \q Es más profundo que el lugar de los muertos; ¿qué puedes saber?
es.R: Es más alto que el cielo. ¿Qué puedes hacer? \q Es más profundo que el lugar de los muertos. ¿Qué puedes saber?

fr.L: [C’est comme] les hauteurs des cieux : que peux-tu faire ? \q Plus profond que le Shéol : que peux-tu savoir ?
fr.B: C’est plus haut que les cieux : que peux-tu faire ? \q C’est plus profond que le séjour des morts : que peux-tu savoir ?
fr.R: C’est plus haut que le ciel. Que peux-tu faire ? \q C’est plus profond que le séjour des morts. Que peux-tu savoir ?

sw.L: [Ni kama] vimo vya mbingu; utafanya nini? \q Kina chake kinapita Kuzimu; utajua nini?
sw.B: Ni juu kuliko mbingu; waweza kufanya nini? \q Ni chini kuliko Kuzimu; waweza kujua nini?
sw.R: Ni juu kuliko anga. Unaweza kufanya nini? \q Ni chini kuliko Kuzimu. Unaweza kujua nini?

vi.L: [Điều ấy như] các tầng trời cao; anh làm được gì? \q Sâu hơn Âm Phủ; anh biết được gì?
vi.B: Điều ấy cao hơn các tầng trời; anh làm được gì? \q Điều ấy sâu hơn Âm Phủ; anh biết được gì?
vi.R: Điều ấy cao hơn bầu trời. Anh làm được gì? \q Điều ấy sâu hơn nơi của người chết. Anh biết được gì?

ko.L: [그것은] 하늘의 높음이니, 그대가 무엇을 하겠소? \q 스올보다 깊으니, 그대가 무엇을 알겠소?
ko.B: 그것은 하늘보다 높은데, 그대가 무엇을 할 수 있겠소? \q 스올보다 깊은데, 그대가 무엇을 알 수 있겠소?
ko.R: 그것은 하늘보다 높소. 그대가 무엇을 할 수 있겠소? \q 죽은 사람들이 있는 곳보다 깊소. 그대가 무엇을 알 수 있겠소?

decisions.choice: it: the limit of God's being and wisdom, from verses 6-7
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no subject. The adjectives in verses 8-9 are feminine, matching "limit" in verse 7 (and "wisdom" in verse 6), so "it" is what Zophar has just said no one can reach.

decisions.choice: Sheol: the world of the dead, pictured as deep under the earth
decisions.reason: Sheol is the place of the dead. Set against the heights of heaven it marks the furthest depth there is (Psalm 139:8; Amos 9:2). Verses 8-9 measure height, depth, length and breadth, the whole world, and find God's wisdom greater than all of it.

decisions.choice: the grave
decisions.reason: Readable says "the grave" for Sheol, as elsewhere in Job; Literal and Balanced keep the name.

decisions.choice: "el lugar de los muertos" (B, R); "el Seol" (L)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what Sheol is, as in the Psalms; Literal keeps the name.

decisions.choice: "죽은 사람들이 있는 곳" (R); "스올" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Readable says what Sheol is, as in the Psalms, rather than the English "the grave".

source.text: אֲרֻכָּ֣ה מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִדָּ֑הּ וּ֝רְחָבָ֗ה מִנִּי־יָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Longer than [the] earth [is] its measure, and broader than [the] sea.

en.L: Its measure [is] longer than [the] earth, \q and broader than [the] sea.
en.B: Its measure is longer than the earth \q and wider than the sea.
en.R: It is bigger than the whole earth \q and wider than the ocean.

es.L: Su medida [es] más larga que [la] tierra, \q y más ancha que [el] mar.
es.B: Su medida es más larga que la tierra \q y más ancha que el mar.
es.R: Es más grande que toda la tierra \q y más ancho que el océano.

fr.L: Sa mesure [est] plus longue que [la] terre, \q et plus large que [la] mer.
fr.B: Sa mesure dépasse en longueur la terre \q et en largeur la mer.
fr.R: C’est plus grand que toute la terre \q et plus vaste que l’océan.

sw.L: Kipimo chake [ni] kirefu kuliko nchi, \q na kipana kuliko bahari.
sw.B: Kipimo chake ni kirefu kuliko dunia \q na kipana kuliko bahari.
sw.R: Ni kikubwa kuliko dunia yote \q na kipana kuliko bahari kuu.

vi.L: Số đo của nó dài hơn đất, \q và rộng hơn biển.
vi.B: Kích thước của nó dài hơn đất \q và rộng hơn biển cả.
vi.R: Điều ấy lớn hơn cả trái đất \q và rộng hơn đại dương.

ko.L: 그 치수는 땅보다 길고, \q 바다보다 넓다.
ko.B: 그 크기는 땅보다 길고 \q 바다보다 넓다.
ko.R: 그것은 온 땅보다 크고 \q 바다보다 넓다.

decisions.choice: its measure: the size of the same thing as in verse 8, God's limit or wisdom
decisions.reason: "Its" is feminine, like the adjectives of verse 8, and points back to the limit of the Almighty (verse 7).

decisions.choice: longer and broader: the earth and sea as the widest things a person knows
decisions.reason: With height and depth in verse 8, length and breadth make four measures, the whole of creation. Psalm 139:8-9 uses the same picture of heaven, Sheol and the far side of the sea to say that God is everywhere.

source.text: אִם־יַחֲלֹ֥ף וְיַסְגִּ֑יר וְ֝יַקְהִ֗יל וּמִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: If he passes by and shuts up and calls an assembly, and who can turn him back?

en.L: If {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} passes by and imprisons, \q and calls an assembly, \q who can turn {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} back?
en.B: If {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} passes through and arrests someone \q and calls the court together, \q who can stop {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?
en.R: If God comes by and puts someone in prison \q and calls them to trial, \q no one can stop {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Si {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} pasa y encarcela, \q y convoca una asamblea, \q ¿quién {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} hará volver?
es.B: Si {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} pasa y arresta a alguien, \q y reúne al tribunal, \q ¿quién {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} detendrá?
es.R: Si Dios pasa y mete a alguien en la cárcel \q y lo llama a juicio, \q nadie {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} puede detener.

fr.L: S’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} passe et enferme, \q et convoque une assemblée, \q qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} fera revenir en arrière ?
fr.B: S’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} passe et fait arrêter quelqu’un, \q et rassemble le tribunal, \q qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}en empêchera ?
fr.R: Si Dieu passe et met quelqu’un en prison \q et le convoque en justice, \q personne ne peut {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}arrêter.

sw.L: Akipita na kufunga, \q na kuitisha baraza, \q ni nani awezaye kumrudisha?
sw.B: Akipita na kumkamata mtu, \q na kuikusanya mahakama, \q ni nani awezaye kumzuia?
sw.R: Mungu akipita na kumtia mtu gerezani \q na kumwita mahakamani, \q hakuna awezaye kumzuia.

vi.L: Nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi qua và giam lại, \q và triệu tập hội đồng, \q thì ai có thể khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quay lại?
vi.B: Nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi ngang qua và bắt giữ một người, \q rồi triệu tập phiên tòa, \q thì ai ngăn cản {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được?
vi.R: Nếu Đức Chúa Trời đến, bỏ một người vào tù \q và đưa người ấy ra xét xử, \q thì không ai có thể ngăn cản {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그분께서 지나가시며 가두시고, \q 회중을 불러 모으시면, \q 누가 그분을 돌이킬 수 있겠는가?
ko.B: 그분께서 지나가시다가 사람을 붙잡아 가두시고 \q 재판정을 소집하시면, \q 누가 그분을 막을 수 있겠는가?
ko.R: 하나님께서 오셔서 누군가를 감옥에 가두시고 \q 재판에 부르시면, \q 아무도 그분을 막을 수 없다.

decisions.choice: passes by ... who can turn him back: Job's own words used against him
decisions.reason: Job said that God passes by him unseen, snatches away, and "who can turn him back?" (9:11-12), using the same verbs. Zophar agrees that no one can stop God, but draws the opposite lesson: God acts against the guilty.

decisions.choice: shuts up ... calls an assembly: arrests and brings to trial
decisions.reason: The first verb means to shut in or hand over (as a prisoner). The second means to call people together, here as a court that judges (Ezekiel 16:40; 23:46). The picture is of God arresting a wrongdoer and calling the court.

decisions.choice: no one can stop him
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer no one, so Readable says so; it also names God as the subject.

source.text: כִּי־ה֭וּא יָדַ֣ע מְתֵי־שָׁ֑וְא וַיַּרְא־אָ֝֗וֶן וְלֹ֣א יִתְבּוֹנָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: For he knows men of falsehood, and he sees wickedness, and not does he consider?

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} knows {{gender:people|men}} of falsehood; \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sees wickedness, and will {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} not take note [of it]?
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} knows who is false; \q when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sees wickedness, will {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} not take note of it?
en.R: God knows who the liars are. \q When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sees evil, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} pays attention to it.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} conoce a {{gender:la gente|los hombres}} de falsedad; \q ve la maldad, ¿y no [la] tomará en cuenta?
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sabe quién es falso; \q cuando ve la maldad, ¿no la tomará en cuenta?
es.R: Dios sabe quiénes son los mentirosos. \q Cuando ve el mal, le presta atención.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} connaît {{gender:les gens|les hommes}} de mensonge ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} voit l’iniquité, et n’y prendra-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pas garde ?
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sait qui est faux ; \q quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} voit le mal, n’y prendrait-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pas garde ?
fr.R: Dieu sait qui sont les menteurs. \q Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} voit le mal, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} y fait attention.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anawajua watu wa uongo; \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} anaona uovu, je, hatauzingatia?
sw.B: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anajua aliye mwongo; \q anapoona uovu, je, hatauzingatia?
sw.R: Mungu anawajua waongo. \q Anapoona uovu, anauzingatia.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết những kẻ dối trá; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy điều gian ác, lẽ nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không lưu ý [đến]?
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết ai là kẻ giả dối; \q khi thấy điều ác, lẽ nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không để ý đến?
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời biết ai là kẻ nói dối. \q Khi thấy điều ác, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để ý đến.

ko.L: 그분께서는 거짓된 사람들을 아시고, \q 악을 보시니, 살피지 않으시겠는가?
ko.B: 그분께서는 누가 거짓된지 아신다. \q 악을 보시면 어찌 눈여겨보지 않으시겠는가?
ko.R: 하나님께서는 누가 거짓말쟁이인지 아신다. \q 악을 보시면 그냥 넘기지 않으신다.

decisions.choice: men of falsehood: deceitful, worthless people
decisions.reason: The phrase joins a word for men with shav', falsehood or emptiness (Psalm 26:4, "men of falsehood"). Zophar leaves it to Job to hear himself included.

decisions.choice: a question: will he not take note of it? (he surely will)
alternatives: he sees wickedness without needing to look into it
he sees wickedness, and does he not consider?
decisions.reason: The last words can be read as a question expecting yes, or as a statement that God sees evil at once, without needing to study it. The sense is close either way: no wrong escapes God's notice.

decisions.choice: the liars
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plain word for people of falsehood (m1).

decisions.choice: {{gender:people|men}}
decisions.reason: The word means people of either sex who are false, so the gender setting applies at Literal.

source.text: וְאִ֣ישׁ נָ֭בוּב יִלָּבֵ֑ב וְעַ֥יִר פֶּ֝֗רֶא אָדָ֥ם יִוָּלֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And a man hollow will get a heart, and a colt of a wild donkey a human will be born.

en.L: But a hollow {{gender:person|man}} will get a heart, \q and a wild donkey's colt be born a human!
en.B: A senseless {{gender:person|man}} will become wise \q when a wild donkey's colt is born human.
en.R: A foolish person will become wise \q only when a wild donkey gives birth to a human being!

es.L: Pero {{gender:la persona hueca|el hombre hueco}} adquirirá corazón, \q ¡y el pollino de un asno montés nacerá humano!
es.B: {{gender:La persona insensata|El hombre insensato}} adquirirá sabiduría \q cuando el pollino de un asno montés nazca humano.
es.R: Una persona necia llegará a ser sabia \q ¡solo cuando una burra salvaje dé a luz a un ser humano!

fr.L: Mais {{gender:une personne creuse|un homme creux}} acquerra un cœur, \q et le petit d’un âne sauvage naîtra humain !
fr.B: {{gender:Une personne insensée|Un homme insensé}} deviendra sage \q quand le petit d’un âne sauvage naîtra humain.
fr.R: Un insensé deviendra sage \q seulement le jour où une ânesse sauvage mettra au monde un être humain !

sw.L: Lakini mtu mtupu atapata moyo, \q na mwana-punda wa punda-mwitu atazaliwa mwanadamu!
sw.B: Mtu asiye na akili atapata hekima \q mwana-punda wa punda-mwitu atakapozaliwa mwanadamu.
sw.R: Mpumbavu atakuwa na hekima \q pale tu punda-mwitu atakapozaa mwanadamu!

vi.L: Nhưng người rỗng tuếch sẽ có được tấm lòng, \q và lừa con của lừa rừng sẽ sinh ra làm người!
vi.B: Kẻ thiếu hiểu biết sẽ trở nên khôn ngoan \q khi lừa con của lừa rừng sinh ra làm người.
vi.R: Người ngu dại chỉ trở nên khôn ngoan \q khi lừa rừng đẻ ra một con người!

ko.L: 그러나 속이 빈 사람이 마음을 얻을 것이고, \q 들나귀 새끼가 사람으로 태어날 것이다!
ko.B: 어리석은 사람이 지혜로워지는 것은 \q 들나귀 새끼가 사람으로 태어날 때일 것이다.
ko.R: 미련한 사람이 지혜로워지는 날은 \q 들나귀가 사람을 낳는 날일 것이다!

decisions.choice: an impossible comparison: a fool will become wise when a wild donkey is born human, that is, never
alternatives: but even a hollow man may gain sense, and a wild donkey's colt be born tame (a hope that leads into verses 13-19)
decisions.reason: The two lines are set side by side with only "and" between them. Most likely the second line names something that can never happen, to say that the first never will either. Read the other way, it is a hope that even a stubborn man can be changed, which would lead into Zophar's call to Job in verse 13.

decisions.choice: hollow ... get a heart: a wordplay, empty-headed and gaining understanding
decisions.reason: "Hollow" (navuv) and "get a heart" (yillavev) sound alike in Hebrew. The heart stands for the mind and understanding, as often (12:3; 34:10).

decisions.choice: a wild donkey: an untamed animal of the open country
decisions.reason: The wild donkey stands for stubborn, untamable freedom (Genesis 16:12; Job 39:5-8).

decisions.choice: {{gender:person|man}}
decisions.reason: The saying is about anyone who lacks sense, so the gender setting gives "person" by default.

decisions.choice: {{gender:la persona hueca|el hombre hueco}}; {{gender:La persona insensata|El hombre insensato}}
decisions.reason: The span takes in the adjective so that it agrees with the noun in each wording; the verb phrase "adquirirá sabiduría" fits both.

source.text: אִם־אַ֭תָּ֗ההֲכִינ֣וֹתָ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וּפָרַשְׂתָּ֖ אֵלָ֣יו כַּפֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: If you, you have set your heart, and spread out to him your palms,

en.L: If you yourself set your heart [right] \q and spread out your palms toward {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}},
en.B: If you set your heart right \q and spread out your hands to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}},
en.R: But if you turn your heart to God \q and lift up your hands to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in prayer,

es.L: Si tú dispones tu corazón [rectamente] \q y extiendes tus palmas hacia {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}},
es.B: Si enderezas tu corazón \q y extiendes tus manos hacia {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}},
es.R: Pero si vuelves tu corazón a Dios \q y alzas tus manos hacia {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en oración,

fr.L: Si toi, tu disposes ton cœur [comme il faut] \q et tends tes paumes vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}},
fr.B: Si tu rends ton cœur droit \q et tends les mains vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}},
fr.R: Mais si tu tournes ton cœur vers Dieu \q et lèves les mains vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pour prier,

sw.L: Ikiwa wewe mwenyewe utauelekeza moyo wako [sawasawa] \q na kumnyooshea {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} viganja vyako,
sw.B: Ukiutengeneza moyo wako \q na kumnyooshea {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} mikono yako,
sw.R: Lakini ukimgeuzia Mungu moyo wako \q na kumwinulia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} mikono yako katika maombi,

vi.L: Nếu chính anh dọn lòng mình [cho ngay thẳng] \q và giơ lòng bàn tay hướng về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: Nếu anh dọn lòng ngay thẳng \q và giơ tay hướng về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.R: Nhưng nếu anh hướng lòng về Đức Chúa Trời \q và giơ tay lên cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},

ko.L: 만일 그대가 그대의 마음을 [바르게] 정하고 \q 그분을 향해 그대의 손바닥을 펴면,
ko.B: 그대가 마음을 바르게 하고 \q 그분께 두 손을 펴 들면,
ko.R: 그러나 그대가 하나님께로 마음을 돌리고 \q 그분께 손을 들어 기도하면,

decisions.choice: you: emphatic, now Job's part
decisions.reason: The pronoun "you" is written out for emphasis. Having spoken of God (verses 5-11), Zophar turns to what Job must do. Verses 13-14 set the conditions and verses 15-19 the promise, one long sentence.

decisions.choice: set your heart: make your heart firm and turn it toward God
decisions.reason: The verb means to make firm or ready. With "heart" it means to set one's mind steadily on God (1 Samuel 7:3; Psalm 78:8).

decisions.choice: spread out your palms: lift open hands in prayer
decisions.reason: Prayer was made standing with hands raised and palms open toward heaven (Exodus 9:29; 1 Kings 8:22, 38).

decisions.choice: turn your heart to God ... in prayer
alternatives: set your heart ... spread out your palms
decisions.reason: Readable names God and says that the open hands are a way of praying (m2, m3).

source.text: אִם־אָ֣וֶן בְּ֭יָדְךָ הַרְחִיקֵ֑הוּ וְאַל־תַּשְׁכֵּ֖ן בְּאֹהָלֶ֣יךָ עַוְלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: if wickedness [is] in your hand, put it far away, and do not let dwell in your tents injustice,

en.L: if wickedness [is] in your hand, put it far away, \q and do not let injustice dwell in your tents,
en.B: if there is wrong in your hand, put it far away, \q and let no injustice live in your tents,
en.R: if you are doing something wrong, stop it, \q and do not let any evil stay in your home,

es.L: si la maldad [está] en tu mano, aléjala, \q y no dejes que la injusticia habite en tus tiendas,
es.B: si hay mal en tu mano, échalo lejos, \q y no dejes que la injusticia viva en tus tiendas,
es.R: si estás haciendo algo malo, déjalo, \q y no permitas que ningún mal se quede en tu casa,

fr.L: si l’iniquité [est] dans ta main, éloigne-la, \q et ne laisse pas l’injustice habiter dans tes tentes,
fr.B: s’il y a du mal dans ta main, rejette-le loin, \q et ne laisse aucune injustice demeurer sous tes tentes,
fr.R: si tu fais quelque chose de mal, arrête, \q et ne laisse aucun mal rester dans ta maison,

sw.L: ikiwa uovu [uko] mkononi mwako, uuweke mbali, \q wala usiache udhalimu ukae hemani mwako,
sw.B: kama kuna uovu mkononi mwako, uuondoe mbali, \q wala usiruhusu udhalimu ukae katika hema zako,
sw.R: kama unafanya jambo baya, liache, \q wala usikubali uovu wowote ukae nyumbani mwako,

vi.L: nếu điều gian ác [ở] trong tay anh, hãy dẹp nó đi xa, \q và đừng để sự bất công ở trong các lều của anh,
vi.B: nếu tay anh có điều sai trái, hãy vứt bỏ nó thật xa, \q và đừng để sự bất công trú trong lều anh,
vi.R: nếu anh đang làm điều sai, hãy thôi đi, \q và đừng để điều ác nào ở lại trong nhà anh,

ko.L: 그대의 손에 악이 [있거든] 그것을 멀리 버리고, \q 그대의 장막에 불의가 머물지 못하게 하면,
ko.B: 그대 손에 잘못이 있거든 멀리 치워 버리고 \q 그대의 장막에 불의가 깃들지 못하게 하면,
ko.R: 그대가 무슨 나쁜 일을 하고 있다면 그만두고 \q 그대의 집에 어떤 악도 머물지 못하게 하면,

decisions.choice: in your hand: in what you are doing or holding
decisions.reason: Wrong "in the hand" is wrong that a person is doing, or something wrongly gained that he still holds (1 Samuel 24:12; Psalm 7:4).

decisions.choice: your tents: your home and household
decisions.reason: "Tent" stands for a person's home and all who live in it, even for people who lived in houses (5:24; 8:22).

decisions.choice: if you are doing something wrong, stop it
alternatives: if wickedness is in your hand, put it far away
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the picture of the hand means (m1).

source.text: כִּי־אָ֤ז׀תִּשָּׂ֣א פָנֶ֣יךָ מִמּ֑וּם וְהָיִ֥יתָ מֻ֝צָ֗ק וְלֹ֣א תִירָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: for then you will lift up your face without blemish, and you will be firmly cast and not fear.

en.L: then indeed you will lift up your face without blemish; \q you will be firmly set and will not fear.
en.B: then you will lift up your face without shame; \q you will stand firm and have no fear.
en.R: Then you will be able to hold your head up with no shame. \q You will be strong and not be afraid.

es.L: entonces sí levantarás tu rostro sin mancha; \q serás firme y no temerás.
es.B: entonces levantarás el rostro sin vergüenza; \q estarás firme y no tendrás miedo.
es.R: Entonces podrás andar con la cabeza en alto, sin vergüenza. \q Serás fuerte y no tendrás miedo.

fr.L: alors oui, tu lèveras ton visage sans tache ; \q tu seras solidement établi et ne craindras pas.
fr.B: alors tu lèveras le visage sans honte ; \q tu tiendras ferme et n’auras pas peur.
fr.R: Alors tu pourras garder la tête haute, sans honte. \q Tu seras fort et tu n’auras pas peur.

sw.L: ndipo hakika utakapoinua uso wako bila dosari; \q utakuwa imara wala hutaogopa.
sw.B: ndipo utakapoinua uso wako bila aibu; \q utasimama imara bila hofu.
sw.R: Ndipo utaweza kuinua kichwa chako bila aibu. \q Utakuwa na nguvu wala hutaogopa.

vi.L: thì chắc chắn anh sẽ ngẩng mặt lên không tì vết; \q anh sẽ vững vàng và không sợ hãi.
vi.B: thì anh sẽ ngẩng mặt lên không hổ thẹn; \q anh sẽ đứng vững và không còn sợ hãi.
vi.R: Bấy giờ anh sẽ có thể ngẩng cao đầu, không còn xấu hổ. \q Anh sẽ mạnh mẽ và không sợ gì.

ko.L: 그때에 참으로 그대가 흠 없이 얼굴을 들고, \q 굳게 서서 두려워하지 않을 것이오.
ko.B: 그때에 그대는 부끄럼 없이 얼굴을 들고 \q 굳게 서서 두려움이 없을 것이오.
ko.R: 그러면 그대는 부끄러움 없이 고개를 들 수 있을 것이오. \q 그대는 강해지고 두려워하지 않을 것이오.

decisions.choice: lift up your face: look up with confidence, with nothing to be ashamed of
decisions.reason: Job said that even if he were in the right he could not lift up his head, so full was he of shame (10:15). Zophar answers that if Job turns to God he will be able to (compare 22:26; 2 Samuel 2:22).

decisions.choice: blemish: a flaw or defect, here a moral one
decisions.reason: The word (mum) is used of a defect that made an animal unfit to offer (Leviticus 22:20). Here it means any stain of guilt.

decisions.choice: firmly cast: solid, like metal poured into a mold
decisions.reason: The word means poured or cast, as metal is (37:18; 38:38), and so solid and firm. Job will stand steady instead of trembling.

decisions.choice: without shame (B); with no shame (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the blemish means for Job's face: nothing to be ashamed of (m1, m2). Literal keeps "blemish".

source.text: כִּי־אַ֭תָּה עָמָ֣ל תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח כְּמַ֖יִם עָבְר֣וּ תִזְכֹּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: For you, trouble you will forget; like waters [that] have passed by you will remember [it].

en.L: For you will forget [your] trouble; \q like waters [that] have passed by you will remember [it].
en.B: You will forget your trouble; \q you will remember it like water that has flowed away.
en.R: You will forget your troubles. \q You will remember them only like water that has flowed past.

es.L: Porque tú olvidarás [tu] aflicción; \q como aguas [que] han pasado [la] recordarás.
es.B: Olvidarás tu aflicción; \q la recordarás como agua que ya pasó.
es.R: Olvidarás tus problemas. \q Solo los recordarás como agua que ya pasó de largo.

fr.L: Car toi, tu oublieras [ta] peine ; \q comme des eaux [qui] sont passées, tu t’en souviendras.
fr.B: Tu oublieras ta peine ; \q tu t’en souviendras comme d’une eau qui s’est écoulée.
fr.R: Tu oublieras tes malheurs. \q Tu ne t’en souviendras que comme d’une eau qui a coulé plus loin.

sw.L: Kwa maana wewe utaisahau taabu [yako]; \q utaikumbuka kama maji [yaliyokwisha] kupita.
sw.B: Utaisahau taabu yako; \q utaikumbuka kama maji yaliyokwisha kutiririka.
sw.R: Utazisahau shida zako. \q Utazikumbuka tu kama maji yaliyokwisha kupita.

vi.L: Vì anh sẽ quên [nỗi] khổ nhọc; \q anh sẽ nhớ [nó] như nước [đã] trôi qua.
vi.B: Anh sẽ quên nỗi khổ của mình; \q anh sẽ nhớ đến nó như dòng nước đã trôi đi.
vi.R: Anh sẽ quên những nỗi khổ của mình. \q Anh chỉ còn nhớ đến chúng như dòng nước đã chảy qua.

ko.L: 그대가 [그대의] 고난을 잊을 것이며, \q 흘러간 물처럼 [그것을] 기억할 것이오.
ko.B: 그대는 그대의 고난을 잊고, \q 흘러가 버린 물처럼 그것을 기억할 것이오.
ko.R: 그대는 고생을 잊을 것이오. \q 흘러가 버린 물처럼 어렴풋이 기억할 뿐일 것이오.

decisions.choice: trouble: misery, painful toil
decisions.reason: The word ('amal) means toil and the misery that goes with it. Job used it of his own nights and months (3:10; 7:3).

decisions.choice: remembered like water that has passed: only faintly, no longer as present pain
decisions.reason: Water that has flowed by is gone and does not come back. Job will remember his trouble only as something past.

source.text: וּֽ֭מִצָּהֳרַיִם יָק֣וּם חָ֑לֶד תָּ֝עֻ֗פָה כַּבֹּ֥קֶר תִּהְיֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And more than noonday will rise [your] lifespan; [though] it is dark, like the morning it will be.

en.L: And [your] life will rise brighter than noonday; \q [though] it is dark, it will be like the morning.
en.B: Your life will be brighter than noonday; \q its darkness will become like the morning.
en.R: Your life will shine brighter than the noon sun. \q Even your darkest times will be like the morning.

es.L: Y [tu] vida se levantará más brillante que el mediodía; \q [aunque] se oscurezca, será como la mañana.
es.B: Tu vida será más brillante que el mediodía; \q su oscuridad se volverá como la mañana.
es.R: Tu vida brillará más que el sol del mediodía. \q Aun tus momentos más oscuros serán como la mañana.

fr.L: Et [ta] vie se lèvera plus éclatante que le plein midi ; \q [si] elle s’obscurcit, elle sera comme le matin.
fr.B: Ta vie sera plus lumineuse que le plein midi ; \q ses ténèbres deviendront comme le matin.
fr.R: Ta vie brillera plus que le soleil de midi. \q Même tes heures les plus sombres seront comme le matin.

sw.L: Na maisha [yako] yatang'aa kuliko adhuhuri; \q [ijapokuwa] giza, yatakuwa kama asubuhi.
sw.B: Maisha yako yatang'aa kuliko adhuhuri; \q giza lake litakuwa kama asubuhi.
sw.R: Maisha yako yatang'aa kuliko jua la mchana. \q Hata nyakati zako za giza kuu zitakuwa kama asubuhi.

vi.L: Và đời [anh] sẽ mọc lên sáng hơn giữa trưa; \q [dù] tối tăm, nó sẽ như buổi sáng.
vi.B: Đời anh sẽ rực sáng hơn giữa trưa; \q bóng tối của nó sẽ trở nên như buổi sáng.
vi.R: Đời anh sẽ chiếu sáng hơn mặt trời giữa trưa. \q Ngay cả những lúc tối tăm nhất cũng sẽ như buổi sáng.

ko.L: [그대의] 삶이 한낮보다 밝게 떠오르고, \q 어두워도 아침처럼 될 것이오.
ko.B: 그대의 삶은 한낮보다 밝을 것이고, \q 그 어둠은 아침처럼 될 것이오.
ko.R: 그대의 삶은 한낮의 해보다 더 밝게 빛날 것이오. \q 가장 어두운 때도 아침처럼 될 것이오.

decisions.choice: life: the span of a lifetime
decisions.reason: The word (cheled) means the length or course of a life (Psalm 39:6; 89:48).

decisions.choice: it is dark: a verb, "though it grows dark", or a noun, "darkness"
alternatives: you will fly (from a verb meaning to fly)
decisions.reason: The word is rare and its form is unusual. Most likely it means darkness: whatever is dark in Job's life will become like morning. Either way the line promises light.

decisions.choice: noonday and morning: the reverse of Job's land of darkness
decisions.reason: Job spoke of going to a land of deep darkness where even the light is like darkness (10:21-22). Zophar promises him the opposite.

decisions.choice: be brighter (B); shine brighter (R)
decisions.reason: Life "rising" more than noonday pictures it shining like the sun at its height; Balanced and Readable say "brighter".

source.text: וּֽ֭בָטַחְתָּ כִּי־יֵ֣שׁ תִּקְוָ֑ה וְ֝חָפַרְתָּ֗ לָבֶ֥טַח תִּשְׁכָּֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will trust, because there is hope; and you will search, in security you will lie down.

en.L: And you will be secure, because there is hope; \q you will look around, [and] lie down in security.
en.B: You will feel secure, because there is hope; \q you will look around you and rest in safety.
en.R: You will feel safe, because you have hope. \q You will look around and then lie down without fear.

es.L: Y estarás seguro, porque hay esperanza; \q mirarás alrededor, [y] te acostarás seguro.
es.B: Te sentirás seguro, porque hay esperanza; \q mirarás a tu alrededor y descansarás tranquilo.
es.R: Te sentirás a salvo, porque tendrás esperanza. \q Mirarás a tu alrededor y te acostarás sin miedo.

fr.L: Et tu auras confiance, car il y a de l’espérance ; \q tu regarderas autour de toi, [et] te coucheras en sécurité.
fr.B: Tu te sentiras en sécurité, car il y a de l’espérance ; \q tu regarderas autour de toi et reposeras en paix.
fr.R: Tu te sentiras en sécurité, parce que tu auras de l’espoir. \q Tu regarderas autour de toi, puis tu te coucheras sans crainte.

sw.L: Nawe utakuwa salama, kwa sababu kuna tumaini; \q utatazama pande zote, [na] kulala salama.
sw.B: Utajiona salama, kwa sababu kuna tumaini; \q utatazama kandokando yako na kupumzika salama.
sw.R: Utajisikia salama, kwa sababu una tumaini. \q Utatazama huku na huko, kisha ulale bila hofu.

vi.L: Anh sẽ được vững lòng, vì có hy vọng; \q anh sẽ nhìn quanh [rồi] nằm xuống bình an.
vi.B: Anh sẽ thấy an tâm, vì có hy vọng; \q anh sẽ nhìn quanh và nghỉ ngơi an toàn.
vi.R: Anh sẽ thấy yên ổn, vì anh có hy vọng. \q Anh sẽ nhìn quanh rồi nằm xuống mà không sợ gì.

ko.L: 소망이 있으므로 그대는 안심할 것이며, \q 둘러보고 평안히 누울 것이오.
ko.B: 소망이 있으니 그대는 안심하고, \q 주위를 둘러본 뒤 편히 쉴 것이오.
ko.R: 그대에게 소망이 있으니 그대는 마음을 놓을 것이오. \q 주위를 둘러보고 두려움 없이 누울 것이오.

decisions.choice: be secure ... in security: trust and safety, one root
decisions.reason: The verb and the noun come from one root meaning to trust and so to feel safe. Zophar repeats it to stress the peace Job would have.

decisions.choice: hope: Job will have a future to look forward to
decisions.reason: Job said his days come to an end without hope (7:6). Zophar promises hope to Job if he repents, and in verse 20 takes it away from the wicked.

decisions.choice: look around: search, as a watchman checks that all is safe before resting
alternatives: be ashamed (a verb with the same letters)
decisions.reason: The verb usually means to dig or to search. Here it most likely means looking about, finding nothing to fear, and lying down. A verb with the same letters means to be ashamed, which fits poorly here.

source.text: וְֽ֭רָבַצְתָּ וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד וְחִלּ֖וּ פָנֶ֣יךָ רַבִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will lie down, and there is no one making afraid; and many will entreat your face.

en.L: And you will lie down, and no one [will] make [you] afraid; \q and many will seek your favor.
en.B: You will lie down with no one to make you afraid, \q and many will seek your favor.
en.R: You will rest, and no one will frighten you. \q Many people will come to ask for your help.

es.L: Y te recostarás, y no [habrá] quien [te] espante; \q y muchos buscarán tu favor.
es.B: Te acostarás sin nadie que te asuste, \q y muchos buscarán tu favor.
es.R: Descansarás, y nadie te asustará. \q Mucha gente vendrá a pedirte ayuda.

fr.L: Et tu te coucheras, et personne ne [te] fera peur ; \q et beaucoup rechercheront ta faveur.
fr.B: Tu te coucheras sans que personne ne t’effraie, \q et beaucoup rechercheront ta faveur.
fr.R: Tu te reposeras, et personne ne te fera peur. \q Beaucoup de gens viendront te demander de l’aide.

sw.L: Nawe utajilaza, wala hakuna wa kukutia hofu; \q na wengi watatafuta fadhili zako.
sw.B: Utajilaza bila mtu wa kukutisha, \q na wengi watatafuta fadhili zako.
sw.R: Utapumzika, wala hakuna atakayekutisha. \q Watu wengi watakuja kuomba msaada wako.

vi.L: Anh sẽ nằm nghỉ, và không ai làm [anh] sợ hãi; \q và nhiều người sẽ tìm ơn của anh.
vi.B: Anh sẽ nằm nghỉ mà không ai làm anh sợ, \q và nhiều người sẽ tìm kiếm ân huệ của anh.
vi.R: Anh sẽ được nghỉ ngơi, và không ai làm anh sợ. \q Nhiều người sẽ đến nhờ anh giúp đỡ.

ko.L: 그대가 누워도 [그대를] 두렵게 할 자가 없고, \q 많은 사람이 그대의 얼굴을 구할 것이오.
ko.B: 그대가 누워도 그대를 겁줄 사람이 없고, \q 많은 사람이 그대의 호의를 구할 것이오.
ko.R: 그대가 쉬어도 아무도 그대를 겁주지 못할 것이오. \q 많은 사람이 그대에게 와서 도움을 청할 것이오.

decisions.choice: lie down with no one to make you afraid: the peace God promised his people
decisions.reason: The verb pictures a flock lying down at rest. The words "and no one will make you afraid" are the promise of Leviticus 26:6, repeated by the prophets (Micah 4:4; Zephaniah 3:13).

decisions.choice: entreat your face: seek your favor
decisions.reason: To "soften the face" of someone is to ask for their favor (Exodus 32:11; Proverbs 19:6). Job would again be a man whose help others sought, as he had been (29:7-25).

decisions.choice: come to ask for your help
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what it is to seek someone's favor (m2).

source.text: וְעֵינֵ֥י רְשָׁעִ֗ים תִּ֫כְלֶ֥ינָה וּ֭מָנוֹס אָבַ֣ד מִנְהֶ֑ם וְ֝תִקְוָתָ֗ם מַֽפַּח־נָֽפֶשׁ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: But eyes of wicked [ones] will fail, and refuge has perished from them, and their hope [is] a breathing out of life.

en.L: But the eyes of [the] wicked will fail, \q and refuge has perished from them, \q and their hope [is] a breathing out of life.
en.B: But the eyes of the wicked will fail; \q there will be no escape for them, \q and their only hope will be to breathe their last.
en.R: But wicked people will look for help and not find it. \q They will have no way to escape. \q The only thing they can hope for is death.

es.L: Pero los ojos de [los] malvados desfallecerán, \q y el refugio les ha faltado, \q y su esperanza [es] exhalar la vida.
es.B: Pero los ojos de los malvados desfallecerán; \q no tendrán escapatoria, \q y su única esperanza será dar el último suspiro.
es.R: Pero los malvados buscarán ayuda y no la hallarán. \q No tendrán forma de escapar. \q Lo único que pueden esperar es la muerte.

fr.L: Mais les yeux des méchants s’épuiseront, \q et le refuge leur a échappé, \q et leur espoir [est] d’exhaler leur vie.
fr.B: Mais les yeux des méchants s’épuiseront ; \q il n’y aura pas d’échappatoire pour eux, \q et leur seul espoir sera de rendre le dernier soupir.
fr.R: Mais les méchants chercheront du secours sans en trouver. \q Ils n’auront aucun moyen d’échapper. \q La seule chose qu’ils peuvent espérer, c’est la mort.

sw.L: Lakini macho ya waovu yatafifia, \q na kimbilio limewapotea, \q na tumaini lao [ni] kutoa roho.
sw.B: Lakini macho ya waovu yatafifia; \q hawatakuwa na pa kukimbilia, \q na tumaini lao pekee litakuwa kukata roho.
sw.R: Lakini waovu watatafuta msaada wasiupate. \q Hawatakuwa na njia ya kutoroka. \q Kitu pekee wanachoweza kutumaini ni kifo.

vi.L: Nhưng mắt của [kẻ] ác sẽ mờ đi, \q và nơi ẩn náu đã mất khỏi chúng, \q và hy vọng của chúng [là] trút hơi thở cuối cùng.
vi.B: Nhưng mắt kẻ ác sẽ hao mòn; \q chúng sẽ không có lối thoát, \q và hy vọng duy nhất của chúng là trút hơi thở cuối cùng.
vi.R: Nhưng kẻ ác sẽ tìm sự giúp đỡ mà không thấy. \q Chúng sẽ không có đường nào để trốn thoát. \q Điều duy nhất chúng còn trông đợi là cái chết.

ko.L: 그러나 악인들의 눈은 쇠하고, \q 피할 곳이 그들에게서 사라지며, \q 그들의 소망은 목숨을 내쉬는 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 악인들은 눈이 흐려지고 \q 피할 길이 없을 것이며, \q 그들의 유일한 소망은 마지막 숨을 거두는 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 악한 사람들은 도움을 찾아도 얻지 못할 것이다. \q 그들은 도망칠 길이 없을 것이다. \q 그들이 바랄 수 있는 것은 죽음뿐이다.

decisions.choice: the eyes fail: they look for help in vain until their strength gives out
decisions.reason: Eyes that "fail" or "waste away" are worn out by looking for help that does not come (Deuteronomy 28:32; Lamentations 4:17; Job 17:5).

decisions.choice: a breathing out of life: death; the only thing left for them to hope for
alternatives: their hope will vanish like a breath
decisions.reason: The phrase means breathing out one's life, dying. Zophar ends, as Bildad did (8:22), with the fate of the wicked. Job had wished to die (3:21; 7:15), and the words may be meant to warn him.

decisions.choice: their only hope (B); the only thing they can hope for (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "only" to make clear that death is all that is left to them (m2).

decisions.choice: look for help and not find it
decisions.reason: Readable says what the failing eyes mean (m1).

decisions.choice: "kutoa roho" (L), "kukata roho" (B) for the breathing out of life
decisions.reason: Both are the Swahili idioms for breathing one's last; Readable says "kifo", as the English says "death".
